simple.summary: יָאָה (yâʼâh) means to be suitable First listed occurrence: Jer 10 7.

definitions.full: H2969. yaah [ יָאָה ] verb befit, be befitting (Late Hebrew יָאֶה יָאֵי, ᵑ7 adjective worthy, fitting, fine ; יָאוּת adverb right, well ; Phoenician יא fair ; Syriac adjective for נאוה Psa 33:1 , πρέπει Matt 3:15 ) — Qal Perfect יָאָ֑תָה לְךָ Jer 10:7 , for thee it (i.e. fear) is befitting , late Aramaism. יְאוֺר see יְאֹר . יַאֲזַנְיָה יַאֲזַנְיָ֫הוּ, see below אזן above יָאִירִי יָאִיר, see below אור above
